Hi, nice to meet you 
My name is Alexander 

I’m currently looking for a 1-bedroom apartment in Dubai for my client.

Requirements:
•	Move-in: from 4th of April
•	Duration: 12 months
•	Payment: monthly payments 
•	Floor: not higher than the 10th floor
•	Pet: small dog 🐶 

Budget: AED 10,000 - 12,000 per month.

Please let me know if you have any available options in Dubai Hills, JLT or Dubai Marina in modern buildings.
